criteria.requirement: Implement simplejson.patch.apply_patch(document,operations) supporting RFC6902 add/remove/replace/move/copy/test on the completed pointer semantics. Work on a deep copy; inputs and operation values must remain unchanged on success or any later error. Array add inserts and dash appends; move resolves destination after removal and rejects moving a parent into its child. Test uses JSON equality with booleans distinct from numbers. Root replacement/add is supported and root remove returns None by explicit API convention. Missing members, invalid operations and paths fail clearly.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
